imbalance_experiment.justification: Per-model imbalance selection (independent validation Macro-F1 with tie_tolerance=0.0020, neural_epochs_cap=10): MLP -> 'smote', CNN -> 'smote', XGBoost -> 'none'.

MLP.justification: Data-driven selection chose 'smote' with highest validation Macro-F1=0.7695 (Weighted-F1=0.9788, Macro-Recall=0.7924, mlogloss=0.0569), beating runner-up 'none' by +0.0770 Macro-F1 (> tolerance=0.0020; Unweighted ('none') Macro-F1=0.6924 (Weighted-F1=0.9763, mlogloss=0.0626); Class-Weight ('class_weight') Macro-F1=0.4046 (Weighted-F1=0.8575, mlogloss=0.5528)).

CNN.justification: Data-driven selection chose 'smote' with highest validation Macro-F1=0.7501 (Weighted-F1=0.9787, Macro-Recall=0.8455, mlogloss=0.0642), beating runner-up 'none' by +0.2407 Macro-F1 (> tolerance=0.0020; Unweighted ('none') Macro-F1=0.5094 (Weighted-F1=0.9780, mlogloss=0.0722); Class-Weight ('class_weight') Macro-F1=0.4150 (Weighted-F1=0.8395, mlogloss=0.4949)).

XGBoost.justification: Tie within tolerance (tol=0.0020): Unweighted ('none') Macro-F1=0.9518, Hybrid SMOTE ('smote') Macro-F1=0.9518 fall within 0.0020 of peak validation Macro-F1=0.9518 (gap=0.0000 vs 'smote'); tie within tolerance, simplest strategy selected -> 'none' (Weighted-F1=0.9989, Macro-Recall=0.9323, mlogloss=0.0046; Hybrid SMOTE ('smote') Macro-F1=0.9518 (Weighted-F1=0.9989, mlogloss=0.0044); Class-Weight ('class_weight') Macro-F1=0.9446 (Weighted-F1=0.9981, mlogloss=0.0092)).

MLP.decision: Reverted to baseline 'cross_entropy' for MLP (baseline val Macro-F1=0.8134; no variant exceeded +0.0020 tolerance within bounded neural budget).

CNN.decision: Reverted to baseline 'cross_entropy' for CNN (baseline val Macro-F1=0.8701; no variant exceeded +0.0020 tolerance within bounded neural budget).

xgboost_optimization.selection_note: No meaningful improvement: Optuna tuned val Macro-F1 (0.9561) changed by +0.0056 vs baseline (0.9504), within baseline CV std=0.0121; retaining baseline.
xgboost_optimization.cv_method_note: Unified 5-fold StratifiedKFold on the development pool (162,577 rows = train+val, held-out test excluded) with per-fold preprocessing and 'none' imbalance handling (sample ddof=1 std across folds).

hardware.notes: TensorFlow GPU not available on native Windows (>=2.11 CPU-only) or no CUDA runtime; using CPU. XGBoost CUDA acceleration verified and enabled.

ensemble_analysis.honest_verdict: Ensemble fusion 'stacking' (Test Macro-F1=0.9660) is comparable to XGBoost, difference not statistically significant (XGBoost=0.9661; observed delta=-0.0001, paired bootstrap n=1000 mean diff=-0.0001, 95% CI=[-0.0140, +0.0146] includes 0; statistically_significant=False). Standalone XGBoost is kept as the supervised default with the Autoencoder orthogonal.

anomaly_detector_comparison.degenerate_fusion_note: Validation selected a single-detector fusion; no gain from fusing detectors on this data.
anomaly_detector_comparison.verdict: Best binary F1 at 95th-pct threshold: Autoencoder (F1=0.6926 [0.6820, 0.7020], Recall=0.6523, FPR=0.0522); best overall ROC-AUC ranking: Autoencoder (ROC-AUC=0.8676); validation-selected option (leave-attack-out non-test): 'Score-Level Fusion (degenerate: equals Autoencoder)'. Validation selected a single-detector fusion; no gain from fusing detectors on this data.

unseen_attack_protocol.scientific_note: Experimental novelty-detection protocol: the supervised classifier cannot assign a label to 'Web Attack' when omitted from training (0.0% class recall), whereas the benign-only Autoencoder evaluates structural divergence from learned benign normality via reconstruction MSE.

validation_vs_test_agreement.summary: Validation ranking agrees with test (Spearman rho=0.8415; top bounded-FPR option is 'Lower P(Benign) Gate (1 - P_Benign > tau) (P99)' on both splits).

mitigation_experiments.verdict: Descriptively on the held-out test partition (not used for selection), Lower P(Benign) Gate (1 - P_Benign > tau) (P99) shows focus attack recall 0.3585 at Benign FPR=0.0119 vs baseline 0.2137 (Benign FPR=0.0003).

by_day_protocol.caveat_note: Open-set cross-day protocol (by_day): by construction in CICIDS2017, all Thursday and Friday attack families (Bot, DDoS, Infiltration, PortScan, Web Attack) have zero training instances in Monday-Wednesday data. Closed-set multi-class Macro-F1 is therefore near zero by design rather than ordinary generalization degradation. The real empirical finding is that supervised XGBoost misses ~72% of unseen attack flows (binary recall=0.2829, precision=0.9970), which is why benign-only anomaly detectors are kept as a supplementary zero-day signal.

profile_selection.justification: Data-driven selection chose 'class_weight' with highest validation Macro-F1=0.8754 (Weighted-F1=0.9443, Macro-Recall=0.9566, mlogloss=0.3263), beating runner-up 'none' by +0.0220 Macro-F1 (> tolerance=0.0020; Unweighted ('none') Macro-F1=0.8534 (Weighted-F1=0.9556, mlogloss=0.0872)). Validation Benign FPR (time_block): 'class_weight'=0.0803 vs 'none'=0.0619. Random-split validation context: 'none' Macro-F1=0.9518 vs 'class_weight' Macro-F1=0.9446.

mitigation_experiments.verdict: Descriptively on held-out test, raising recall above baseline (0.7968 at Benign FPR=0.0144; peak option 'Lower P(Benign) Gate (1 - P_Benign > tau)' [P90] reaches 1.0000 at Benign FPR=0.0401) incurs an elevated false-positive rate cost (> +2% FPR); the active production profile is therefore kept unchanged and trade-offs are reported transparently.
